verdict.rationale: EBANX documents a no-code option: payments are created in the EBANX dashboard and shared with customers as a link. It also offers a hosted checkout page that EBANX manages. Together these cover the 'send a request customers pay online' core, but nothing describes invoice documents (line items, numbering, due dates) or any automatic reminders. Missing for 10: hosted invoice objects/documents, automatic payment reminders/dunning for invoices, due-date management, independent corroboration.
